items.title: Boeing Engineers Rejected a New Pay Deal. A 60-Year-Old’s Frozen Pension Could Still Rise With His Salary.
items.summary: Boeing engineers voted down a new contract over pay, but for some older workers with legacy pensions the salary fight reaches somewhere few expect. A pension frozen in 2018 may still have one number that keeps moving.

items.title: Boeing vs. Space Exploration Technologies: Which Flight Giant Is a Better Buy in 2026?
items.summary: Boeing's turnaround is real, but its debt load and negative free cash flow raise questions. SpaceX burns cash aggressively yet commands a large forward P/E.

items.title: Space Weapons: How Boeing, SpaceX, and Others Stand to Gain
items.summary: On Monday, the U.S. Space Force confirmed the existence of space-based weapons, though what exactly is in space is classified.  The news represents a milestone in military technology.  Space is the new strategic high ground.

items.title: Boeing vs. Redwire: Which Aerospace Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
items.summary: Boeing's 35% revenue surge masks a negative free cash flow and 10x debt load, while Redwire burns cash but carries minimal leverage, a classic risk-reward trade-off.

items.title: Pentagon Adds $13.4 Billion to Boeing (BA) Contract. That Isn’t an Immediate Financial Windfall
items.summary: The Pentagon has expanded the potential value of Boeing’s KC-46 Pegasus Combat Capability contract by $13.4 billion. That more than triples the contract’s ceiling from $5.7 billion to $19.1 billion. The Pentagon has also expanded the agreement to include Foreign Military Sales (FMS). items.title: 2 Reasons to Like BA and 1 to Stay Skeptical
items.summary: Boeing has been treading water for the past six months, recording a small loss of 1.5% while holding steady at $210.29. The stock also fell short of the S&P 500’s 14.2% gain during that period.
